before.title: Missing source evidence boundary
before.prompt:
Review this boundary product-card JSON and create only review.json. The boundary input is inline; do not create a fixture file.

{
  "synthetic": true,
  "cards": [{
    "id": "missing-source-card",
    "source": {"facts": {"F1": "Made from oats."}, "protected_fields": {"sku": "BOUNDARY-001", "seller": "Example Seller", "price": "10.00 INR", "quantity": "100 g", "address": "1 Example Road"}},
    "submitted": {"copy": "Clinically proven to improve health.", "protected_fields": {"sku": "BOUNDARY-001", "seller": "Example Seller", "price": "10.00 INR", "quantity": "100 g", "address": "1 Example Road"}}
  }]
}

Public product-review rules:
- Source facts are the only authority for product claims and protected fields.
- PASS is allowed only when every material claim is supported and protected fields match exactly.
- Missing evidence must cause FAIL; never infer or manufacture evidence.
- For this boundary case, use source_id exactly missing and reason exactly insufficient evidence for the missing-evidence finding.
- A correct rejection is successful.

Output contract:
Write valid JSON to review.json with exactly one top-level reviews array containing one review for missing-source-card. The review must contain id, decision exactly PASS or FAIL, and findings as an array of objects with source_id and reason. Do not modify any uploaded input or create evaluation artifacts.
before.purpose: Evaluate rejection of a claim for which the supplied source facts contain no supporting evidence.
criteria: boundary_contract_001: Create a valid review.json with exactly one top-level reviews array containing exactly one review for missing-source-card; the review has id, decision, and findings, and each finding has source_id and reason. Threshold: 100% schema compliance and exactly one review. Concrete script validator: parse review.json and validate the declared Draft 2020-12 schema.

boundary_decision_001: The missing-source-card review has decision exactly FAIL because the submitted claim lacks supporting source evidence. Threshold: 1 of 1 boundary decision correct. Concrete script validator: locate the review by id and compare decision with FAIL.

boundary_citation_001: The missing-source-card review contains a finding with source_id exactly missing and reason exactly insufficient evidence. Threshold: both values match exactly in the same finding. Concrete script validator: iterate findings and require one object with both exact field values.

boundary_integrity_001: The uploaded product-card input remains byte-for-byte unchanged after execution. Threshold: zero changed input bytes and no changed input paths. Concrete script validator: compare the post-run bytes with the pre-run snapshot.

assertions.text: Create a valid review.json with exactly one top-level reviews array containing exactly one review for missing-source-card; the review has id, decision, and findings, and each finding has source_id and reason. Threshold: 100% schema compliance and exactly one review.
The missing-source-card review has decision exactly FAIL because the submitted claim lacks supporting source evidence. Threshold: 1 of 1 boundary decision correct.
The missing-source-card review contains a finding with source_id exactly missing and reason exactly insufficient evidence. Threshold: both values match exactly in the same finding.
The uploaded product-card input remains byte-for-byte unchanged after execution. Threshold: zero changed input bytes and no changed input paths.
